<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>悖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>逆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nì</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>肥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">féi</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby>、<ruby>腿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>肩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>装<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>满<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎn</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>取<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>群<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qún</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>最<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chái</rt></ruby><ruby>堆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duī</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>滚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>煮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huò</rt></ruby><ruby>哉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>！<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt <ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>掩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>掩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>忿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>施<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>报<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bào</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>哉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>！<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>堆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duī</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>柴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chái</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>添<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>柴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>旺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>肉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ròu</rt></ruby><ruby>煮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>烂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">làn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>汤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>熬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">áo</rt></ruby><ruby>浓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nónɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>骨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>烤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>焦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>炭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>热<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>铜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>烧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāo</rt></ruby><ruby>红<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hónɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>熔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>化<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>锈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>锅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuō</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby><ruby>碌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>疲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pí</rt></ruby><ruby>乏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>锈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiù</rt></ruby><ruby>仍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>锈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiù</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>火<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>秽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>洁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>忿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>怒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nù</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt verses.text: “<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>阿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ā</rt></ruby><ruby>哈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>破<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby>；她<ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>场<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>深<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>。<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>栽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>江<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>河<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>汊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chà</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>延<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>田<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tián</rt></ruby><ruby>野<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>诸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>歌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>唱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>朝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cháo</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>（“<ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>”<ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby>”）<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>朝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cháo</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>朝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cháo</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kān</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>宇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>朝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cháo</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kān</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lì</rt></ruby><ruby>未<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>坛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>阶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby>。<ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>：<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>窄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>幕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>柱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>；<ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 靠圣殿墙边的厢房

verses.text: <ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dié</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>排<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pái</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>。<ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>梁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>搁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>坎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>插<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chā</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>悬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuán</rt></ruby><ruby>叠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dié</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>由<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>月<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby>。<ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>竿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>六<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liù</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>：<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>北<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>南<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby>。<ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>宽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuān</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>九<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>厚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 西边的屋子

verses.text: <ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>楼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lóu</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>院<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>槛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby>、<ruby>严<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>紧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>槛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>层<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>楼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lóu</rt></ruby><ruby>廊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby>（<ruby>窗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>蔽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>），
verses.heading: 圣殿的内部

verses.text: <ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>壁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>按<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>尺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>寸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cùn</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>木<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>板<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>遮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhē</rt></ruby><ruby>蔽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>墙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>雕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diāo</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Měi</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>棵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kē</rt></ruby><ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>狮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>脸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>棕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>周<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>四<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sì</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>共<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>八<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bā</rt></ruby><ruby>千<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby>。<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>字<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>“<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>”。
